title: Steam Next Fest October 2026: 7,164 demos, at least 1,054 with AI disclosures (SteamDB via GamingOnLinux); press page 8,202, more than double last year (Eurogamer)

claims.text: At least 1,054 with an AI disclosure notice
Press page count 8,202; more than double last year
Real AI share may be higher (undisclosed use)
